name: pyforge-mason
description: Mason station CLI grammar for the recipe, package and environment crafts plus doctor, reached as pyforge mason or POST /stations/mason/mcp. Use when running pyforge mason recipe, package, environment or doctor commands, scripting Mason exit codes or --format json output, or working in src/shared/packages/pyforge-mason/. Do not import pyforge.mason internals; the CLI is the public contract. Do not use for recipe knowledge such as pins, selectors or build fixes; conda-forge-expert owns recipe semantics and Mason's recipe verbs only wrap it.
compatibility: N/A -- internal station CLI, not a published library
